text: Attempt 2: compact layout so homes sit next to jobs. Bands top to bottom: homes, shops, factories, shops, homes; cross streets every 10 tiles; power lines through every band.
Day one: $10,000 bond (4%), tax 4%.
Avenue x=76 to the north edge + neighbor link, 6 streets (y=20..55), cross streets x=86/96/106, coal plant next to the factory band, 6 riverbank pumps, pipes under every band.
Shops in the rest of both shop bands; 9 more riverbank pumps (water spare capacity was 21%).
Second block south (y56-89): homes, shops, factories in the same band pattern, power lines, pipes; 11 more riverbank pumps.
Coal plant ran out (power spare 0%), pumps lost power and water fell to 0. Built a second coal plant (x107-110, y70-73); water and power back within 2 months.
18 more riverbank pumps (water spare was 0%), a third coal plant (x107-110, y35-38), third bond, tax 5%.
Factories in the empty middle bands of the south block (y63-68, y77-82): factory demand maxed, 15% unemployed.
14 more pumps at the river bend (x59-66, y48-49).
East block (x107-126, y20-90): 11 street extensions, cross street x=116, homes and factories in alternating bands, power lines x=111/121, pipes. Fourth bond, tax 6%.
Fifth bond, tax 7%. Fourth coal plant (x122-125, y42-45) and 8 pumps at the east lake.
Sixth bond. South block (y91-124, x80-126): homes and factories in alternating bands, cross streets, power lines, pipes, 15 river pumps (x72-79, y99-100) and 9 at the bend.
Seventh bond. Fifth coal plant in the northeast (x121-124, y13-16; a spot next to homes was refused by citizens). 42 more pumps at the river bend.
Only 37 of 132 pumps had power: pumps don't pass power to each other. Rebuilt the pump fields with power lines between every two rows (and x=73), plus lines along the south pumps.
Sixth coal plant in the southwest (x74-77, y113-116) wired straight into the south block: buildings with power 83% -> 97%.

Eighth bond. North district (y1-19): dense shops (shop demand maxed for years), homes y1-5, power lines. Seventh coal plant (x66-69, y114-117). First fire station (x97-99, y7-9) and police station (x87-89, y7-9).
North district had no power (its lines connected to nothing). Fed it with a line from the pump line up x=75 and along the top map edge.
North strip y1-5 changed from homes to factories; new factory/shop strip between river and avenue (x54-75, y56-75) with pipes and power lines. 643 empty homes and 18% unemployed: the city needs jobs.
Tenth bond, tax 7%. Police stations, a fire station and a hospital (newspaper: 'Citizens Request Protection').
Road along old power column x=101 (y20-54) to relieve north-south traffic; demolition used up all cash.
